briefing: Keep your voice down and your data slate closer. There's three tonnes of narcotics that needs to move, and it can't go through anyone who asks questions.
Fly it past the patrols and set it down clean, with no scanner catching sight of the hold. You get paid when it lands, not before.
{PATRON} doesn't advertise this kind of work, and {HERE} doesn't need to hear about it either.

run.arrive: Set the three tonnes down at {TARGET} unscanned, and {PAY} is waiting
run.success: The narcotics reached {TARGET} clean, and {PAY} lands in the account
run.fail: The scan caught the hold before {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays where it was

dossier.lead: Word reaches the commander that {PATRON} wants a quiet word, back at {WORLD}

rumour.far: Traders say a smuggler's run passes through {WORLD}, and {PATRON} arranges it
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the cargo had better not be late

dossier.news: {PATRON} is said to have quiet cargo work waiting at {WORLD}

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander agreed to run three tonnes of narcotics out of {WORLD}, no questions asked.

closing.complete: The commander delivered the narcotics clean, and by day {DAY}, {WORLD} was none the wiser.
closing.fail: The deadline passed on day {DAY}, and the narcotics never reached a buyer near {WORLD}.

run.success: The commander slipped the narcotics past the patrols and collected the fee, far from {WORLD}, by day {DAY}.
run.failed: A patrol scan caught the hold before delivery, and by day {DAY} the deal near {WORLD} was dead.

dossier.title: Three Tonnes, No Questions
